ios.desc:
Your phone won't stop interrupting you. Here's the way out.

Apps are designed to grab your attention. Notifications hijack your focus. Your home screen triggers mindless scrolling. Superagency shows you exactly how much control you've lost — then gives you a personal plan to take it back.

How it works

Answer a few questions about your phone habits. In 3 minutes you'll get:
* Your Agency Score (0-100): One number that shows how much your phone controls you
* Your Week 1 action plan: The top-3 changes that will make the biggest difference for your setup
* Step-by-step guidance: Tap through to silence the noise, hide triggers, and rewire your phone habits

Track real progress

Your Agency Score combines screen time, pickups, notifications, and app habits. Watch it improve week by week as you make changes. No guilt, just data. 
Superagency keeps you on track with quick weekly tune-ups that adapt your plan as your setup and habits change.

Who this is for

You know something's wrong but don't know where to start. You've tried blockers that feel like punishment. You want specific fixes and measurable progress, not vague advice.

Get your Agency Score and personal plan in 3 minutes. Start today.

Link to the Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

quotes.text:
Hey HN,

I kept trying phone detox apps but they all felt punitive – like I was fighting myself. So I built something different: a diagnostic tool that measures phone control as a single number (0-100).

Your Agency Score combines screen time, pickups, notification patterns, and app usage into one metric. Take a 3-minute assessment, get your score + a personalized action plan for your specific setup.

Free assessment, premium for ongoing tracking. Would love feedback on the scoring algorithm or UX. What metrics would you want to see?

Btw, you can try it on Mac as well. Link: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/superagency/id6757364702
